card.name: Percent of variance explained
card.fires_on: Words right after a percentage in phrases saying a factor explains a share of the variation or variance, such as 'of', 'the' and 'variation'. Also seen before regression terms like 'multiple logistic regression'.

modes.label: Share of variation explained
modes.description: Linking words and the word variation or variance after 'explains X percent'.
